books.title: Five little pigs
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.plot: Hercule Poirot investigates a murder that happened sixteen years ago by questioning the five people who were there on that day.

books.title: Love hypothesis
books.author: Ali Hazelwood
books.plot: A PhD student wants to convince her best friend that she is happy and dating someone, so she agrees to a fake relationship with a famous young professor. What starts as a simple arrangement slowly turns into something neither of them planned. The story mixes humour, science and a lot of awkward moments in a university lab.
